title: •Arica
caption: •Arica (V)
game_text: Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke’s location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.
lore: Mara Jade posed as a dancer at Jabba’s Palace in an attempt to complete her master’s task and kill Luke. *Musician*. *Spy*. Unable to convince Jabba to take her on his skiff.

notes: Sheet group: Everything else. Unique. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 5 / FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only), deploy 5 / forfeit 7 — all as printed. Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow DS helmet), warrior (blue, blaster) — as printed. Affiliation: two discs top-left on the printed card, alien (eyes) and Imperial → 'Alien + Imperial' (wiki subtype Alien/Imperial). No credits on this slip. Curly apostrophe Luke’s. Slip text matches the stub. LORE CORRECTED from the 745 px scan: curly apostrophes Jabba’s, master’s; 'Musician' and 'Spy' printed BOLD (periods plain) → *Musician*. *Spy*. Base scan Ref2-D-arica.gif is 745 px but tagged D-E1 at the corner (PC errata face: its game text prints “break cover” in double quotes where the wiki printed text has 'break cover') — the only Decipher scan; used as src, lore/art as printed. Copyright legible: '© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' Modern: V0-D-arica.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 0 — same game text as this slip); VB4-D-arica-pre (353) also exists, not downloaded.
